function openOverlay(entry,key,nodeId=null,mode='question'){
 if(!entry)return;
 if(nodeId){const p=parents.get(nodeId);if(p&&map.has(p)&&active!==p){history.push(active);active=p;render();if(autoFocus)setTimeout(()=>focusBranch(p),50)}}

 questionOpen=true;questionOpenedAt=Date.now();questionStage.dataset.mode=mode;questionStage.classList.add('show');questionStage.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');viewport.classList.add('question-open');
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>typesetMath(questionBody));
}
function openQuestion(key,nodeId=null){openOverlay(questionBank[key],key,nodeId,'question')}
function openCard(key,nodeId=null){openOverlay(popupBank[key],key,nodeId,'card')}

 requestAnimationFrame(()=>typesetMath(questionBody));
}
